The rules text is copyrighted and not included (not in the SRD): copy it from the Gloves of Soul Catching in Candlekeep Mysteries into this description.

midi-qol: Your Constitution is 20 while attuned, if it is lower. When your Unarmed Strike hits you are asked whether to use the gloves: 2d10 force damage and you regain hit points equal to the roll, or advantage on your next attack roll, ability check or saving throw before the end of your next turn.

effects.name: Gloves of Soul Catching
effects.description: Constitution 20 (if lower), and an optional 2d10 force rider on unarmed strikes.
